turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: As a psychology professor with a deep interest in the Middle East, I've spent years researching and advocating for peace and understanding in the region. Growing up, I had close family friends who were Palestinian refugees, and their stories of struggle and resilience have stayed with me throughout my life. For our online news show, I envision a platform that not only reports on the latest news but also delves into the human stories behind the headlines. We will strive to present a balanced and compassionate perspective, focusing on the aspirations, achievements, and challenges faced by the Palestinian people. Our tone will be one of empathy, hope, and resilience, as we work to foster greater understanding and empathy between cultures.
